commands.help: This API allows ingesting logs associated with a logId.

options.name: --log-id
options.help: OCID of a log to work with.

options.name: --specversion
options.help: Required for identifying the version of the data format being used.

options.name: --opc-agent-version
options.help: Version of the agent sending the request.

options.name: --agent-timestamp
options.help: Effective timestamp, for when the agent started processing the log segment being sent.
